faq.beforeSell.heading: Before I start selling
faq.beforeSell.info.whySellOnVinisto: {vinisto} is the first online marketplace and logistics service with wines and spirits on the Czech market. {vinisto} is a platform that helps winemakers reach more customers, build their brand and product awareness. {vinisto} is a logistics service – transport, storage, packing and delivery from you to the customer. {vinisto} builds a community by engaging professionals and the general public through articles, reviews and education. With {vinisto} you save time, increase profits and become independent. The vision of {vinisto} is to sell your goods hassle-free directly to customers worldwide.
faq.beforeSell.info.howItWorks: {vinisto} works like a marketplace. In Czech, the English word {marketplace} is also often used. However, {vinisto} handles the entire logistics process for the seller. The seller registers, lists their products on {vinisto}, sets prices and sells. {vinisto} picks up the goods and stores them in its warehouse. The goods are insured and remain the property of the seller until sold. Upon an order, {vinisto} packs and delivers the goods to the customer. For winemakers, {vinisto} is a specialized platform to sell directly to customers online without dealing with logistics. For customers, the big advantage is being able to buy directly from winemakers, or from multiple winemakers at once, and have everything delivered in one package. Another added value of selling on {vinisto} is that the platform allows you to build community and brand awareness. You can present your winery, products, or review and write about wines. You can become part of the {vinisto} community.
faq.beforeSell.question.howCanIStartSell: How can I start selling on {vinisto}?
Registration of a new seller, winemaker or distributor is possible at {prodejceVinisto}. For registration just enter your contact details and Company ID, the rest will be filled in automatically. We must verify it is you, so we will call you or send a verification e-mail. The more you present your company in your profile, the better your products will sell.

Products can be searched in our global wine database, imported, or added manually. You can immediately see if another seller already sells your products on {vinisto}. You set your own product price – we recommend choosing the same or lower price than it usually sells for online.

We will check your profile and products, and if we find anything that needs to be completed, we will contact you immediately. Then we will send you your first stocking request. The required quantity is carefully chosen to minimize stock while ensuring customer comfort, so their order can be delivered quickly in one package. We either pick up the goods, or you deliver them to our warehouse – and you are selling.
faq.beforeSell.question.conditions: What requirements must I meet to sell on {vinisto}?
faq.beforeSell.info.conditions: Be a producer, importer, distributor of wine and spirits, and be a VAT payer.
faq.beforeSell.question.contract: Why do I need a contract?
faq.beforeSell.info.contract: Every professional, honest and transparent business relationship should be clearly contractual so both parties know their rights and obligations. The contract sets all rights and obligations of the seller to ensure a quality service for customers and also for sellers.
faq.whatToSell.heading: What can be sold on {vinisto}
faq.whatToSell.info.items: On {vinisto} you can sell wines, port, and spirits. Soon we will also allow sales of services such as tastings, cellar stays, etc.
faq.whatToSell.question.promotions: Can I run promotions and discounts?
faq.whatToSell.info.promotions: Yes, you can adjust your product prices at any time. Price settings are done easily in your account administration. If you discount a product, for 30 days we will show both the original price and the discounted price. If you increase the price, only the new higher price will be shown.
faq.whatToSell.question.tasting: Can I sell tastings and winery events on {vinisto}?
faq.whatToSell.info.tasting: We are currently preparing the option to sell services such as tastings and winery events. Their sale will be enabled soon. Sales fees will be the same as for product sales. However, you do not pay logistics fees – sales are only online, nothing is stored and nothing is physically shipped to the customer.
faq.howItWorks.heading: How selling through {vinisto} works
faq.howItWorks.info.cooperation: A condition for selling on {vinisto} is to hold at least a minimal but sufficient amount of stock in the {vinisto} warehouse. {vinisto} offers sellers two options of cooperation. Sellers can deliver goods directly to the {vinisto} warehouse at Sanderova 1366/26 in Prague 7 themselves and then pay a lower logistics commission. The second option is to use collection directly by {vinisto}, with the sales commission being a few percent higher. The method that suits you can always be agreed with your sales representative or support at {phone}, or you can change it anytime in your administration panel.
faq.howItWorks.question.canBeChangedCoop: Can the cooperation method be changed?
faq.howItWorks.info.canBeChangedCooperat: You choose the cooperation method during registration. This method, i.e. the delivery type from you to us, can be changed at any time in your administration panel.
faq.howItWorks.question.myProducts: Can someone else sell my product on {vinisto}?
faq.howItWorks.info.myProducts: {vinisto} is a marketplace. So it can happen that your goods are also offered by another distributor or even the producer directly.
faq.howItWorks.question.customerCare: Does {vinisto} provide customer support? To what extent?
faq.howItWorks.info.customerCare: {vinisto} has a whole customer care department. All customer inquiries and requests, including complaints, are handled by Vinisto. Sellers don’t need to deal with customers in this regard. Customer care does not act as a shopping advisor – if a customer needs help choosing products, they can rely on reviews, articles and more available on {vinisto}.
faq.commission.heading: Commissions and payments
faq.commission.question.whenToPay: When do I pay commission for goods I offer through {vinisto}?
faq.commission.info.whenToPay: You only pay commission for goods sold through {vinisto}. You pay nothing for transport to the warehouse or for storage. At the end of each month, {vinisto} sends you a settlement and, based on it, issues an invoice to itself with 14-day maturity.
faq.commission.question.howYouPayMe: How will I be paid for my sales?
faq.commission.info.howYouPayMe: {vinisto} pays your sales once a month. At the end of each month {vinisto} prepares a settlement of sold goods and commissions, based on which it issues an invoice to itself. If there were no sales in the past month, you pay nothing and you won’t receive an invoice.
faq.commission.question.canFeesBeChanged: Can {vinisto} change sales and logistics fees?
faq.commission.info.canFeesBeChanged: Yes, it can happen. We aim to change sales and logistics fees as little as possible. However, if necessary, e.g. due to drastic increases in transport costs, sellers will see everything transparently and can decide whether to continue selling on {vinisto}.
faq.prices.heading: Product prices
faq.prices.question.howToSet: How should I set prices for selling on {vinisto}?
faq.prices.info.howToSet: You set your product prices yourself – we recommend setting the same or a lower price than what your product usually sells for online.
faq.prices.info.canVinistoEditMyPrices: Yes, but only within its sales commission. If {vinisto} decides to discount a product by 10%, the discount comes from {vinisto}’s commission and the seller still receives the full price without discount. {vinisto} will minimize such discounts from its own fee, as otherwise the platform would not have funds to operate.
faq.promotions.heading: Promotions and marketing
faq.promotions.info.howItWorks: {vinisto} uses all marketing channels to promote your goods and the portal itself. In addition to social networks, where the focus is mainly on building brand awareness and community, it also uses performance campaigns, brand campaigns and advertising on product comparison sites. All these marketing activities are already included in the fee and you don’t pay anything extra.
faq.promotions.question.canIPromote: Can I make my products more visible directly on {vinisto}?
faq.promotions.info.canIPromote: Yes, in the future it will be possible to promote your products and winery directly on {vinisto}. We will offer sellers several types of marketing packages. A seller can choose a package during registration in the administration panel or order it anytime later. For more information, contact your sales representative or seller support at {phone}.
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.heading: Transport and storage
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.info.whereStore: Goods are stored at Sanderova 1366/26 in Prague 7. The {vinisto} warehouse conditions are suitable even for natural wines. All goods in storage are insured.
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.question.howItW: How does delivery of goods to {vinisto} work?
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.info.howItWorks: Goods are stored at Jankovcova 1057/6 in Prague 7. During registration you choose the delivery method that suits you and an approximate pickup time. This method and time can be changed anytime in the settings in the admin panel or by arrangement with seller support.
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.question.howToC: I am delivering goods to {vinisto} warehouse but can’t come at the agreed time, what should I do?
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.info.howToChang: We know delays can happen for many reasons. If you can’t arrive at the agreed time, please inform us through the admin panel or the seller support phone line.
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.question.nobody: {vinisto} was supposed to pick up the goods from me at the agreed time, but nobody came, what should I do?
faq.shippingAndWarehouse.info.nobodyPick: In such a case, please inform us as soon as possible, either through the admin panel or on the seller support phone line.
